questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{若}X\sim N(0,1),\,Y\sim \chi^2(n),\,\text{且}X\text{与}Y\text{相互独立，则}T=\frac{X}{\sqrt{Y/n}}\sim t(n);\\&\text{若}X\sim \chi^2(m),\,Y\sim \chi^2(n),\,\text{且}X\text{与}Y\text{相互独立，则}F=\frac{X/m}{Y/n}\sim F(m,\,n).\\&X_1-X_2\sim N(0,2),\,X_1^2+X_4^2\sim \chi^2(2),\,\text{且相互独立，所以}\frac{X_1-X_2}{\sqrt{X_1^2+X_4^2}}=\frac{(X_1-X_2)/\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{(X_3^2+X_4^2)/2}}\sim t(2).\\&X_1+X_2\sim N(0,2),\,X_1^2+X_3^2\sim \chi^2(2),\,\text{但不相互独立，所以不能说明}\frac{X_1+X_2}{\sqrt{X_1^2+X_2^2}}=\frac{(X_1+X_2)/\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{(X_1^2+X_2^2)/2}}\text{服从}t(2).\\&X_1\sim N(0,1),\,\sum_{i=2}^{n}X_i^2\sim \chi^2(n-1),\,\text{且相互独立，所以}\frac{\sqrt{n-1}X_1}{\sqrt{\sum_{i=2}^{n}X_i^2}}=\frac{X_1/1}{\sqrt{\sum_{i=2}^{n}X_i^2/(n-1)}}\sim t(n-1).\\&\sum_{i=1}^{3}X_i^2\sim \chi^2(3),\,\sum_{i=4}^{n}X_i^2\sim \chi^2(n-3),\,\text{且相互独立，所以}\frac{(n-3)^{\frac{3}{2}}X_1^2}{3\sum_{i=4}^{n}X_i^2}=\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{3}X_i^2/3}{\sum_{i=4}^{n}X_i^2/(n-3)}\sim F(3,\,n-3).\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{令 }Y_1=\sqrt{a}(X_1-2X_2),Y_2=\sqrt{b}(3X_3-4X_4),\ \text{则 }Y_1=Y_2^2+Y_2^2,\\&\text{为使 }Y\sim \chi^2(2),\ \text{必有 }Y_1\sim N(0,\ 1),\ Y_2\sim N(0,\ 1),\ \text{因而}\\&\quad E(Y_1)=0,\ D(Y_1)=1,\ \ E(Y_2)=0,\ D(Y_2)=1,\\&\text{注意到 }D(X_1)=D(X_2)=D(X_3)=D(X_4)=4,\ \text{由}\\&\quad D(Y_1)=D[\sqrt{a}(X_1-2X_2)]=aD(X_1-X_2)=a(D(X_1)+2^2D(X_2))\\&\quad=a(4+4\times 4)=20a=1,\\&\quad D(Y_2)=D[\sqrt{b}(3X_3-4X_4)]=bD(3X_3-4X_4)\\&\quad=b(9D(X_3)+16D(X_2))=b(4\times 9+16\times 4)=100b=1,\\&\text{分别得 }a=\frac{1}{20},\ b=\frac{1}{100}\text{。这时 }Y\sim \chi^2(2),\ \text{自由度为 }n=2.\end{aligned}

\begin{aligned}&\text{解法一}\quad Y=[\sqrt{a}(X_1-2X_2)]^2+[\sqrt{b}(3X_3-4X_4)]^2,\\&\quad\text{令}Y_1=\sqrt{a}(X_1-2X_2),Y_2=\sqrt{b}(3X_3-4X_4),\ \text{则}&&Y=Y_1^2+Y_2^2,\\&\quad\text{为使}Y\sim\chi^2(2),\ \text{必有}Y_1\sim N(0,1),Y_2\sim N(0,1),\ \text{因而}&&\\&\quad E(Y_1)=0,D(Y_1)=1,\ E(Y_2)=0,D(Y_2)=1,\\&\text{注意到}D(X_1)=D(X_3)=D(X_4)=4,\ \text{由}&&\\&\quad D(Y_1)=D[\sqrt{a}(X_1-2X_2)]=aD(X_1-X_2)=a(D(X_1)+2^2D(X_2))\\&\quad=a(4+4\times 4)=20a=1,\\&\quad D(Y_2)=D[\sqrt{b}(3X_3-4X_4)]=bD(3X_3-4X_4)\\&\quad=b(9D(X_3)+16D(X_4))=b(4\times 9+16\times 4)=100b=1,\\&\text{分别得}a=\frac{1}{20},b=\frac{1}{100}.\ \text{这时}Y\sim\chi^2(2),\ \text{自由度为}n=2.\end{aligned}
\begin{aligned}&\text{解法二}\quad\text{因}X_1\sim N(0,2^2)\text{且相互独立，知}&&\\&\quad X_1-2X_3=X_1+(-2)X_2\sim N(0,20),\ \ 3X_3-4X_4=3X_3+(-4)X_4\sim N(0,100),\\&\quad\text{故}\ \frac{X_1-2X_2}{\sqrt{20}}\sim N(0,1),\ \frac{3X_3-4X_4}{\sqrt{100}}\sim N(0,1),\ \text{为使}&&\\&\quad Y=\left(\frac{X_1-2X_2}{1/\sqrt{a}}\right)^2+\left(\frac{3X_3-4X_4}{1/\sqrt{b}}\right)^2\sim\chi^2(2),\\&\quad\text{必有}\ \frac{X_1-2X_2}{1/\sqrt{a}}\sim N(0,1),\ \frac{3X_3-4X_4}{1/\sqrt{b}}\sim N(0,1),\\&\quad\text{与上面两个服从标准正态分布的随机变量比较即是}&&\\&\quad\frac{1}{\sqrt{a}}=\sqrt{20},\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{b}}=\sqrt{100},\ \text{即}a=\frac{1}{20},b=\frac{1}{100}.\end{aligned}
